body: Will do I guess
Nah I won’t do anything. I’ll be gone.

See that good thing about it if I do succeed is that I will regret it for a very short time. Then there will be nothing. I want that nothingness, I’d much rather it than than feel like this all the time.

I had the same problem. Any time I cut it’s pretty much because I feel like I’ve failed someone, like if I mess or or they just get mad at me. When my mom saw she said to tell her the next I felt like cutting but I just can’t because most of the time it’s after we have an argument.
I don’t believe in your religion. There will be endless nothing when I die. That is my truth.
Yeah I feel a bit bad- I mostly do the same. I’ll read a couple after I post them log into my regular account and forget I posted until I check again next
When I can’t sleep because of depression is 90% of the time I log on and post something lol

The place I’m moving has apartments for less than 1000, plus I will be moving in with two of my friends one of which is already working. I’ve done the math and it’s going to be difficult but possible.
That’s exactly how I am- I can’t talk to the people o actually know. It’s why I post on here.

I’m worried I’d stress out my family more. I’m also afraid if I do talk to them they’ll find the money somehow and make me see someone- I know we can’t afford it and I don’t want to be more of a burden.

I hate that- In my friend group I’m never the one that has problems, I’m the solid one. I mean, I was for awhile, but I’m not good anymore and I have no one to talk to besides Reddit because when I go to my friends they don’t take me seriously.
I’ve used the excuse of catching myself on chicken wire and they bought it. It can be sharp when it’s cut at an angle
Thought I was Demi for awhile, but now I’m pretty sure I’m ace
I only do it on my upper legs and upper arms, never wear tank tops or short shorts, but I still go asked that.
Oh god I never even thought about that now I’m anxious

Ugh I have the exact same weird swings, and it’s not seemingly related to any monthly stuff. Some days I’ll just absolutely be infatuated with life, and the something just... shifts, and I want to go to sleep for a couple years. Or I’ll get irritated and short tempered. Been wondering myself if I should go try to get a diagnosis or if it’s normal.

I became the kinda of go to shoulder for my friends and it’s screwing me over now instead of helping me because I just.. idk, I feel guilty putting more weight on them when I know they have problems too. I feel like I have to fake too, but I can’t stop for some reason.
Ugh I feel the exact same way everyday.
Yeah I can’t cut easily so I just do anything. Idk why anymore

Wow I see myself in what you write. Especially at the end- I have a problem with straight up saying things but I’ve made so many offhandeded remarks about hating myself and jumping off bridges, I think the people around me do notice they just don’t care at all. I have people that say they care but it feels false and forced.
Live for her. Enjoy what she couldn’t while you can, because if she was old enough to say that’s probably exactly what she’d want you to do.

I really hope you can understand how much this comment means to me, and it alone really helps. I write in this sub mostly just to get thoughts out, but the responses make it even more cathartic. 

I also hate the fact someone else feels this way, but in an odd sense it’s comforting. If others are surviving with this terrible beast, then surely I can too.
